# Soft Shine Cosmetic — Full Context

## Business

Soft Shine Cosmetic supplies beauty and makeup products wholesale to retailers, salons, makeup artists, beauty professionals, resellers, and other beauty businesses. The business is based in Veraval, Gujarat, India.

## Expo

The current public expo is Somnath Beauty Expo at Somnath Expo Hall, Veraval, Gujarat. It is focused on beauty, cosmetics, and professional makeup discoveries for women shaping the industry.

## Registration

Visitors can choose an active expo, enter their name, phone number, email, city, and gender, then complete payment through Razorpay. After payment verification, the registration is confirmed and the visitor can download a PDF ticket containing the registration ID and QR code.

## Contact

Public contact numbers and the business address are available on the homepage. Visitors can call or contact the business through WhatsApp and can open the location in Google Maps.

## Sponsors

The public sponsor area displays JustGold first, followed by Makeup Empire and MaxTouch.
